summary: Expo SDK 54 → SDK 57 (RN 0.86.3 / React 19.2.3 / expo-router 57 / reanimated 4.5.1 / gesture-handler 2.32 / react-native-maps 1.27 / @gorhom/bottom-sheet 5.2.14 / TS 6) FRONTEND-ONLY regression smoke test on web preview (mobile viewport 390x844 + wide 1280x900). RESULT: All requested flows PASS with zero red screen and zero page errors. Details: (1) App boots without blank screen; welcome-screen renders with brand-title, cta-login, cta-register. (2) Login as passager@test.com / password123 succeeds → passenger-home. Password eye toggle (toggle-password) correctly switches password-input type from 'password' → 'text' (no attribute) and back. Logout from Profil (logout-button) returns to welcome. (3) Passenger home: mock MapCanvas.web renders (grid + green marker + APERÇU CARTE label), bottom sheet handle visible, destination-search field opens list of 8 place-N items + fav-save-N stars; typing 'Tour Eiffel' returns OSM-like results (place-W5013364, place-N5327309821 …). Selecting a place opens the ride sheet with vehicle-standard 11.54 €, vehicle-premium 19.23 €, vehicle-van 17.38 €, surcharge-none, schedule-now + schedule-day-*, for-me/for-other, business-toggle + business-switch (Facturer à Acme Conseil 60.00 € restants), pay-cash/pay-card, promo-input + promo-apply, notes-input, price-breakdown, confirm-ride-button, add-to-cart-button. Icons render properly (car / user / clock / wallet / promo glyphs from @react-native-vector-icons/material-design-icons – no empty squares). Bottom tab navigation Accueil / Mes courses / Profil works. (4) Mes courses lists ride cards (ride-card-<uuid>) including 3 en cours; opening a ride card navigates to Chauffeur-en-route detail (driver Peugeot 508 AB-123-CD, 11.54 €, share/message/annulation), back button (ride-back-button) returns. (5) Passenger Profil: wallet-card (balance, referral code DA0061, share-referral, referral-input+apply, wallet-toggle-tx), phone-card, account-section (menu-info, menu-security, menu-help, logout-button) all render; menu-info opens Informations personnelles sheet (settings-name, settings-save) and sheet-close closes it; menu-security opens Sécurité sheet (pwd-current/pwd-new/pwd-confirm/pwd-toggle). (6) Driver (chauffeur@test.com): driver-home renders with online-toggle, gps-chip, current ride card, tabs Accueil / Privées / Équipe / Documents / Gains / Profil ALL render without crash. Privées shows Courses privées stats (0 à venir, 120 € encaissé, 18% commission) with Planning/Historique. Équipe shows Mon équipe (1 chauffeur Karim Équipier Tesla 3) + Comptabilité mensuelle (sept./août/juil./juin/mai/avr.) with export PDF/CSV. Profil renders wallet-card 1.40 €, vehicle Peugeot 508. (7) Entreprise (entreprise@test.com): company-dashboard renders (Acme Conseil, invite-code 424696, budget 60 €, En direct + Historique with company-ride-<uuid>, accounting-export, month-2026-09..2026-04, export-pdf, export-csv). Tab 'Employés' shows Passager 60 €/mois. NOTE: bottom tabs on the company account are 'Tableau de bord / Employés / Entreprise' (not 'Profil') — matches implementation; all three render fine. (8) Register: welcome → cta-register renders back-button, role-passenger/role-driver/role-company selector (toggling swaps form: passenger→Nom complet ; company→Nom de l'entreprise + Nom du responsable), fullname-input, email-input, phone-input, password-input + toggle-password, referral-input (present), register-submit-button, go-to-login. No crash on role toggle. (9) Wide 1280x900: root frame is exactly 480 px wide, centered (400 px on each side). Post-login passenger-home still functional inside the framed column with tabs. Console: 0 page errors, 0 non-4xx console errors across all flows (only expected 401 after logout while the AuthProvider re-checks /auth/me, which is normal). One benign warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' still emitted by react-native-web / third-party libs (was already present at iteration 8; not an SDK 57 regression). No deprecated Expo packages detected (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch in package.json). Conclusion: SDK 57 upgrade did not introduce any UI regression — main agent can ship.

issues: Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (react-native-web / underlying library) – pre-existing, not caused by SDK 57 upgrade

action_items: (No blocker) Optionally silence the recurring 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning by migrating any leftover pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents (search RN Web) – cosmetic only.
(Minor) Company bottom-tab third item is labelled 'Entreprise' rather than 'Profil'. If the intent (per test brief) was a Profil tab for entreprise, decide whether to rename – functional now.
critical_code_review_comments: _layout.tsx: framed column at width ≥ 820 with FRAME_WIDTH=480 and boxShadow via Platform.select — clean migration off deprecated shadow* API.
Zero @expo/vector-icons references confirmed; only @react-native-vector-icons/material-design-icons is used, matching the SDK 57 migration plan.
SplashScreen kept visible until useIconFonts resolves – prevents empty-glyph flash on cold web load. Verified visually (icons render on first paint).
No red-screen ErrorBoundary triggered on any of the 4 role flows; LogBox.ignoreAllLogs(true) is fine for prod-like preview but keep dev logs on during local dev.
seed_data_creation: None – only read-only login flows and UI navigation exercised; existing seeded users used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SDK 57 upgrade is stable on the web preview. Login rate-limit is 8 fails / 15 min per email – reuse tokens when possible. Bottom sheet handle is not exposed via testID; scroll it programmatically only if strictly needed. Company account uses tabs 'Tableau de bord / Employés / Entreprise' (no Profil tab). Passenger destination-search uses OSM-style ids like place-W5013364 – dynamic and change per query; use place-1 for the first prefilled favourite instead. The recurring pointerEvents warning can be ignored – pre-existing library issue.
rca_of_issue: N/A – no bugs found in this iteration.
